purpose: Account of consolidating and reformatting workshops

required_facts.fact: Workshop recordings and materials were scattered across services.
The Workshops section gives access after one sign-up.
The original site was Next.js built with v0 and Cursor.
Claude Code converted READMEs into structured tutorials.
Most are free and deployment workshops are members-only.
AI Hero moved from email lessons to a tracked course.
AI Hero includes comments, progress and a certificate path.
